fusions.name: Gathering Stampede
fusions.desc: Barrels through everything within 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 13 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Both Barrels
fusions.desc: A two-footed hind kick that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Clover Pasture
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of clover where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rested Legs
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
